title: Beyond The Edge
description: Many new dimensions, bosses, mobs, and ores that will help you progress through the mod. It is a progression-based mod, where each dimension increases in difficulty. It is a post-game mod. It is a mod with some story elements.
body:
THE MOD STILL IN BETA!!! 

![Mod Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/02a64344ae20edb83588fbcd2e6bf47ac2c7142a.png)

**Tired of defeating the dragon and then not knowing what to do next?**

**Tired of the boring post-game of just collecting elytra and quitting?**

**Tired of not knowing what to do afterward?**

**_Then this mod is for you!_**

#                                     ABOUT BEYOND THE EDGE

It adds many more explorable dimensions after you defeat the dragon (or even before). Start by exploring the simple dimension of the icelands and venture further until you reach the perilous plains of hell.

Get books that explain the lore of the dimensions, follow in the footsteps of the ancient explorer before you, and gradually delve into their story to discover where they ended up and what their amazing or tragic fate was. (Still a work in progress)

The mod is based on a story apart from the normal gameplay, this mod consists of several dimensions so far having a total of 2 completed and 7 in work, and soon I will add many more depending on the support of the mod. 

[This mod is progressive so first you will have to go to the first dimension before you can go to the next ones, if you want an adventure after the late game you might like this mod, although it is still in development and in a very early phase.]

For more information go: [BEYOND THE EDGE SECRETS AND INFO](https://beyondtheedge.netlify.app/)

And discord: [DISCORD](https://discord.gg/hNQ9Frf2RU)

# HOW TO START?

To access the icelands you will have to look for a structure in the snow biomes or icebergs, although it is very difficult to find so you must be attentive (the structure is small), is like a ruined ice portal.

![Icelands portal](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/261c3fe85223a20b4af6264199da189fff257bea_0.webp)

Once you access this, prepare for the adventure.

[You can find the various flint and steel to access dimensions in the chest of the structure]


# DIMENSIONS

(THIS MOD IS A RE-WORK OF THE OLD BEYOND THE ERA MOD AND IS UNFINISHED)

Soon I will add more dimensions and bosses to each of the current dimensions along with more structures and I am willing to accept ideas.

I made this mod with the help of McCreator and I do the best I can. 

**The order of the dimensions in order of progression is:**

**Chapter 1**
1. IceLands - 95% complete (playable)
1. Ether - 95% complete (playable)

**Chapter 2**
1. Limbo - 80% complete (actual work in progress)
1. MindScape - 10% complete (future update)
1. Oniric - 10% complete (future update)

**Chapter 3**
1. Llanuras del Inferno - 1% complete (only the base dimension and ores)
1. EnderGarden - 0% complete (stil working on it!)

# CHAPTER 1 - ICELANDS

![Icelands](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/81b9b95da637b9df0128ebaa2d8f85177c2aaedc_0.webp)

Once you enter here, your adventure officially begins.

In these frozen lands, your primary objective is to explore the vast terrain, dodging ice skeletons, ice spiders, and ices.

![icelands mobs](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d2ae8c227e802a5a5b7e90f50db664f03a29b437_0.webp)

Find mines and explore them to obtain your first Neoice, Frozen Iron or Ice crystal debris and craft tools and armor from these materials (remember that to mine higher-grade ores, you need their previous versions):

1. Frozen Iron
1. Neoice
1. Ice crystal

![minerales icelands](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/38b93a32c552f4fc52ae3c66c70da54bacaef89e.png)

To obtain your first Frozen Iron armor and tools, you need Netherite tools and armor, which you must then upgrade with a Frozen Iron ingot and its upgrade mold. But...

How do you get the upgrade molds?

![moldes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b961a1f08f8cfe259d57a5b277d058673a978242.png)

EASY!

Look for structures with bosses inside. Chests and bosses will give you your first upgrade molds, allowing you to craft your armor and tools.

## STRUCTURES

![icelands tower 1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ec0867d2fd43c307450744d132ba577347a92786_0.webp)

Find your first structure and master it completely to obtain the Ice Disc from chests or by fiercely battling an ice boss. Be careful, as the difficulty increases the more overpowered you become, so don't expect anything easy for now.

![Ice_disc](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7f18dff4e54e14d47364c5e80cc4358a17ca7391.png)

Once you find the Ice Disc, you can continue your adventure by searching for the next ice structure: The Orb Ring.

![iceorb](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/215378c647716a6e860d84c4f352d8aea67eef3e_0.webp)

Once there, right in the center, you'll find the Ice Jukebox, which will allow you to summon the first boss of all: THE ICEKING

![ICEKING](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/159651fe250228ef52aeea6ef1a013322b11e556_0.webp)


## GO TO THE NEXT DIMENSION

Once the Ice King is defeated, he will give you the next flint and steel to continue your adventure, the infused flint and steel which you can use to power the next portal you can find in the icelands: the portal that takes you to the ether

![Mechero infundido](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5ab7395ff779ecaa42fd1de34d4e88aa75b1f43a.png)
![ether portal](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/06ddb7c786cb3af25dd183ff658663d55d9b6587_0.webp)


# ETHER

![ETHER](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/32f8b515f284462e7d977b3e97997975c5989f72_0.webp)

Once inside the Aether, things get much more complicated. You have to avoid direct confrontations with hordes of enemies, even in broad daylight. Here, it's not just a matter of exploring; it's also about surviving by finding enough materials to craft the next upgrades for your Neoice or Ice Crystal armor.

Order:
1. Frozen Iron
1. Neoice
1. Ice crystal
2. Itium
3. Eterium

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/166fb4cb98a5165c7a5ac4a7417588981602d439.png)

## STRUCTURES

To find the molds for each mineral, you'll need to explore to find the new ether structures, although there are now many more structures with chests, so you don't need to worry about loot unless you find something special.

![Molds](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/325e7094d1ab8301f55797304d89d9da906dfb16.png)

![Pagoda1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d333b4b4f6266e887c2696df2e70fa97a3060eca_0.webp)

Beware of the monsters in each structure!

# SPECIAL LOOT

In this mod, there's something called "special loot." It's basically loot that generally serves one or two specific functions within the mod itself. This type of loot only generates in special dimensions, such as the ether and limbo (for now).

Below, I'll show you some of the possible special loot im the Ether.

## JADE 

Although Jade itself has a crafting recipe, it is one of the first special loots directly from the mod in chests; you can use it inside a brewing stand to make corrupted jade.

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1130634fbd17fdd9b712eafbd183b21e6b7a4f95.png)

## CORRUPTED JADE

After infusing jade in a brewing stand using an etherium ring, you obtain corrupted jade, which will help you get the etherium key that will allow you to continue your adventure.

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b90a2d53a67fde72e0846a0c8754788de49763fe.png)


It will also help you obtain the jade blade, which is used to craft a functional weapon to defeat the dimension's boss, although that's more advanced.

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6be802d802facb04108cc6fbb6c0cdb34b5ee84d.png)

## JADE LITTLE HORSES

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/af212b0bc574c40657f5fa1c07e20d75ea36847b.png)

These little guys also serve as special functional loot for crafting the jade blade.

# CONTINUE YOUR ADVENTURE


Once you have the key to Etherium, you can access the next structure, the Pagoda of Light, where you will find the totem where you can insert the key and summon the first boss of the dimension: the Mossy Assassin.

![eterium key](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7bdb479e6d2666cabff7cb574994d759ab4ecc37.png)
![assasins pagoda](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/96e313c35368271d3af33e5b230afda04b4f7957_0.webp)
This structure is hard to find!

![Assasins totem](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1470127eda192a96b59b47b871767bee5e700034_0.webp)


![Mossy assasin](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/12ebab1af09efee77c9dc361cf3da25c6447b3cf_0.webp)

You need to be careful with this boss, as he has several special attacks that could make things difficult for you. Likewise, you need to defeat him to finally obtain the next disc required to summon the final boss of the dimension.

![Ether disc](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/629efc196c523362545082adb2651be666d0b8b0.png)

## ETHER FINALE

To finish the ether you need to find the last structure where the jukebox plantae lies, place the disc you just got and summon the possessed samurai.

![Finale structure](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0b210d2f31cc2d5aacab4a00cb56c4dd04c6b220_0.webp)

![Jukebox](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0b1251956099a3fe78e6be7316ff4b00697ff0f0_0.webp)

The samurai has many attacks and incredible regeneration; to prevent regeneration you need to hit him many times in a row, hits that are impossible to land if you don't have a very fast weapon or the jade blade, which you can right-click and switch between its two modes to make the battle easier.

# GO BEYOND TO CHAPTER 2

Congratulations, you have successfully completed Chapter 1 of the mod!

The mod is divided into several chapters, covering both story and dimensions and difficulty levels. Chapter 1 is currently 98.8% complete and playable (you can consider it a tutorial).

However, Chapter 2 is still in an early stage of development (you can only access one dimension of Chapter 2): "Limbo." This will give you a glimpse into the future of the mod.

Limbo is the most hostile and difficult dimension of all. It features several special mechanics and incredible, functional items, although the dimension as a whole is not finished (you can defeat the bosses and obtain everything, but it is the last playable dimension).


# CHAPTER 2 - LIMBO

![LIMBO](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bd792e410dd64b1521ca170b1c2a76f7c0dbc332_0.webp)

Here's where we run into problems. The dimension is playable with shaders, but to see it with shaders, you need the Shadow Ring. If you play without shaders, you need the Limboddium Ring.

Things get much more complicated here. Mob souls lie here and are everywhere. Limbo is a cluster of floating islands, so to stay here without falling, you need to tame a Death Phantom.

![death phantom](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bdc85c4efb03341fa094cbec6cc68c6cbb24dbe1_0.webp)

The dimension is very dark, you can't see very far ahead of you with shaders, and the difficulty increases a lot the further you advance.

## LIMBO MECHANICS

![COUNTER](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8ecad3b08321867649b4d9602152d209ea1e8382.png)

You can't stay in limbo!

The longer you stay in limbo, the more your soul will separate from your body, leaving you completely vulnerable. The longer you remain here, the more and more effects will be applied to you. You'll start hearing things and seeing hallucinations.

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4a526d6d9239d7df6385af4a9922b08b2577bd09.png)

The timer will appear at the top of your screen and will decrease when you return to the overworld.

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/43972cf9b47cee4b39c786a028a7cd560901d061.png)


You can't see anything here!!

In limbo, you can't see absolutely anything, not even with torches.

To enter without shaders, you absolutely need to obtain a Lomboddium ring, which is crafted like this:

![limboddium ring](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f79e1d30e066d5d489a95bdcd43c775238ebcc05.png)

Once you regain your sight, you can begin searching for one of the many structures in here.

## STRUCTURES AND ORES

Here ores are scarcer but function in the same way as in the previous dimensions; they are the limboddium and the shadow or shadow ingot.

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5182c509946369c0ac08ad371a6275efca436807.png)

Order:
1. Frozen Iron
1. Neoice
1. Ice crystal
2. Itium
3. Eterium
4. Limboddium
5. Shadow


And their respective templates.

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9125187fb6652f467c15d39bb2a903171f5d8bab.png)

In the structures here you can find a lot of special loot as well as monsters and bosses. In the next tower you can find the Sombraductor, which is the first boss of the dimension.

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/34c9a6fe4147c9688bc8873d23570ae0b49dc0e8_0.webp)

To spawn the sombraductor you need the limboddium key!!

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bc3977103845a7a7869dbdf7bcbc8bedc461bd10.png)


## ALTAR

![Mano de Dios](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/49e12141313045f34c5f6f2188db5ac5357a0079_0.webp)

In limbo you can find a structure known as the Hand of God where you can find an altar to which you can offer your own life (blood) in exchange for loot and upgrades, although be careful because it could backfire.

![altar](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/609825318fd239683480cdfe87e19467da721de0.png)

To use it, you will have to lose a lot of health and remove your rings.


## THE END?

After defeating the shadowducer you will be able to obtain the limbo disc needed to summon the guardian golem, the last boss programmed to date and the most difficult of all.


![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ffcd4fb6b72aae077a593ac02f080ea37531d91b.png)

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1823121c11b4b989ad9f59a8a9a15ac5d36a87a9.png)

Be careful it doesn't fall when it charges at you straight into the void, or you'll have to find another structure!

This boss is still under development, so it may have some bugs.

## SPECIAL LOOT LIMBO

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d3b4f00615769c892d31b4f7a629c75665531c5b.png)

In Limbo, there are several objects that count as special loot. These objects have special and very fun mechanics useful for surviving in Limbo, although you must be careful because, like everything here, they can bring you bad things if you use them too much, or maybe not, who knows?

# SHADERS

**Can I use shaders?**

Of course you can! But some shaders have drawbacks within the mod. In Chapter 2, using shaders might make things much more difficult.

The ones I use and recommend for the mod are Sildus Vibran Shaders.

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/93b0a0eda9a5b5d2a7656b27b17a660ce7e1f861.png)

To use shaders, I recommend using Embeddium and Oculus, as OptiFine is not supported by the mod.

### What's next?

The mod is still under development, so that's all for now. I'll continue updating the mod and fixing bugs soon. Thanks for playing it and for reading all of this.

This mod is not finished yet so... It may have bugs.

DEPENDECES: GECKOLIB, CURIOS API, SCALING HEALTH

**Features summary:**

Likewise, this mod adds certain objects for its own fun since I originally created this mod to use it in a lore for my minecraft server with friends so have fun

Many new dimensions (planed to be 10 dimensions)
Rare objects made only for fun (they don´t have any survival craft yet)
gems with unique powers (gems will apear in chests in feature dimensions)
Many new ores
New crafts
Nes bosses and mobs
New foods like the golden apple
New materials
New armors
New functions
Epic soundtracks for bosses and backgrounds. Many of them were composed by me and a friend (the ones that play in Survival)

IF YOU WANT TO SEE MORE OF THE MOD DEVELOPMENT YOU CAN GO TO THIS YOUTUBE CHANEL:

[BEYOND THE EDGE YOUTUBE CHANEL](https://www.youtube.com/@Beyond_The_Edge_Era)

Many things in this mod are still being worked on or don't have any function and will be added in future updates.

DON'T SUPPORT OPTIFINE
